ops.text: Length-dependent total budgets have also been proposed: AlloKV [⟦new.A1⟧] scales the cache with the input length after finding that the budget needed to stay within one point of full-cache accuracy grows only as the 0.43 power of the context length, yet it, too, decides which tokens to keep from pooled attention alone.

new_bib.text: I. Sadowska, F. Mowat, T. Wierzbicki, and K. Ballantyne (2026). How much cache does a longer prompt need? Allometric budgets for KV-cache eviction. arXiv preprint.
